title: Grilled Nectarine Skewers with Zesty Kenyan Glaze
description: A sweet and tangy summer recipe that combines the flavors of Africa and a hint of spice. Perfect for a light and refreshing dessert.
instructions: Thread nectarines onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together zesty and kenyan to make the glaze.
Brush the glaze onto the nectarines.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the fruit is tender and slightly charred.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
